meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把静态设计变成动感短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做短视频或社媒素材，想让画面更有动感
copy.tagline_en: Turn static designs into eye-catching motion shorts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you make short videos or social media content and want more dynamic visuals.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 制作约 10 秒、无旁白的短动画：文字动效、数字滚动、图表、Logo 亮相、地图或网页滚动等。流程是先定镜头方案、按需找素材，再构建并校验动画，最后渲染成 MP4 或透明背景视频。全程基本自主，渲染前会先征求你的意见。
howto.when: 当你想做约 10 秒、无旁白、以动效为主的短视频（如文字动效、数字滚动、Logo 亮相等）时，该流程会接管。更长、带旁白或多场景的需求会转给 /general-video；不确定时先进 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这句话做成文字动效短片，8 秒，不要旁白。
say.note: 会先规划镜头，再自动渲染视频。

say.text: 帮我把这份数据做成柱状图逐条跳出的动画。
say.note: 会生成图表动画供你预览或渲染。

say.text: 做一个往地名加高亮的动态地图短片。
say.note: 会按地理动效模板制作。

howto.what_en: Claude creates short (~10s, no narration) design-led motion graphics: kinetic text, counter, chart, logo, map/UI/tweet forms. Pipeline: plan shot, source needed assets, build & verify HTML animation, then render MP4 or transparent overlay. One clarifying question max; render requires user approval.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for a short design-led motion graphic (usually under 10s, no narration). Longer, narrated or multi-scene requests go to /general-video; unclear ones go to /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Turn this quote into an 8-second kinetic type clip, no voice-over.
say_en.note: It will plan the shot and render automatically.

say_en.text: Turn this data into a bar chart where bars appear one by one.
say_en.note: It will generate the chart animation.

say_en.text: Make a short animated map that highlights these regions.
say_en.note: It will use the map module to build it.
